subject: Request: annotated HSM ceremony transcript + KEK audit vignettes for SOC 2 / SIG
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aurorafin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Annotated ceremony transcripts + KEK vignettes for SOC 2 review

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning. AuroraFin's SOC 2 audit team asked us for more concrete artifacts showing how Redwood runs HSM key ceremonies and how KEKs are managed across tenant handoffs. Specifically they're looking for: 

- A short, redacted ceremony transcript (timeline + operator actions) with annotations that explain operator roles and checks.
- A couple of small "vignettes" (rows) showing KEK derivation/rotation telemetry for sample tenants across one rotation window (pseudonymized).
- Any short diagram / chain map that ties wrapping keys -> KEKs -> tenant keys for our SOC 2 report.

We appreciate if you can deliver an annotated PDF and a CSV with the vignettes. Ideally something we can hand to the auditor next week (deadline: 2029-07-26). If some parts are sensitive, redaction notes or sanitized examples will work — we just need to show process + demonstrable logs.

Best,
Daniel
AuroraFin Security

--
Daniel Park
Senior Information Security Engineer
AuroraFin

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2029 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annotated ceremony transcripts + KEK vignettes for SOC 2 review

Daniel — thanks for the clear ask. I'll own delivery and loop in Jonas (applied crypto) for the KEK sampling and Ben to keep your procurement/audit contact in the loop. A few quick clarifications so we scope correctly: 

1) For the ceremony transcript: do you want the full operator shift log + narrated timeline, or a condensed transcript that highlights critical decisions (operator IDs redacted)?
2) For vignettes: how many sample tenants would you like? (we can provide 2–3 pseudonymized rows that show HKDF inputs, KEK wrap events, rotation timestamp, and verification hashes).
3) Diagram: we'll provide a PNG chainmap that shows wrapping key ↔ KEK ↔ tenant DEKs and where KMS/HSM boundaries occur.

Tentative plan: Jonas will prepare a pseudonymized CSV (2 tenants) and an explanatory appendix; I'll assemble an annotated PDF transcript (redacted operator ids) and the chainmap PNG. We'll deliver a single ZIP with the three files by 2029-07-19 EOD PST if that works for you.

If that timeline is too tight, tell us the earliest acceptable date.

Thanks — looping Jonas & Ben.

Cheers,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 08:57:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annotated ceremony transcripts + KEK vignettes for SOC 2 review

Marissa / Ben — I prepared the KEK sampling vignettes and a short notes file describing how we pseudonymize inputs. Attached: kek_sampling_vignettes.csv (3 rows), and a short README excerpt inside the ZIP. Key points to include in the annotated transcript:

- Operator checks: dual-sign confirmation for KEK wrap, HSM custody steps, firmware checksum checks prior to ceremony.
- Audit note: KEK rotations are deterministic from the rotation schedule and show a clear provenance chain (wrapping key id -> KEK id -> tenant DEK id) with SHA256 verification.
- Example pseudonymized event row format (csv): rotation_ts, tenant_id_alias, kek_id_alias, wrapping_key_id, verification_hash

I redacted operator names to shift-role tokens (OP_SHIFT_1, OP_SHIFT_2) and removed IP addresses. The CSV includes a synthetic verification_hash column (sha256-like hex).

Attachments referenced: kek_sampling_vignettes.csv (csv), notes_readme.txt (txt).

—Jonas
Applied Cryptography
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverable: annotated HSM ceremony transcript + KEK vignettes (redacted)

Daniel — attaching the package we discussed. Summary below and quick notes for your auditor: 

Attachments in ZIP (hsm_kek_package_aurorafin.zip):
- hsm_ceremony_transcript_annotated.pdf (pdf) — condensed 6-page transcript with inline annotations describing each operator step, checks performed, and redaction notes.
- kek_sampling_vignettes.csv (csv) — three pseudonymized vignettes showing rotation_ts, tenant_alias, kek_alias, wrapping_key_id (opaque), verification_hash.
- redwood-kek-chainmap.png (png) — simple chain diagram showing HSM wrapping key boundaries and KEK derivation paths.

Key prod notes for auditors:
- No tenant plaintext keys are present in the artifacts; the CSV contains derived identifiers only.
- Operator identities are redacted to role tokens; audit logs linking operator tokens to identities are available under formal NDA / request and follow our access controls.
- The annotated transcript includes references to firmware checks and dual-operator confirmation steps — we highlighted the controls that map to SOC 2 CC6.

Deliverable links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example (view-only).

If the auditor needs raw shift logs or signed HSM attestation blobs, please let me know the contact and we can start an evidence handoff (need an executed DPA amendment + access request).

Thanks — ping me if anything needs further redaction or expansion.

Marissa
--
